attribution.title: Filmtheater De Uitkijk, Prinsengracht 452, Amsterdam: a canal house of the 17th century, a cinema since 1913
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with 3DBAG LoD2.2 heights and the 3DBAG shell for the auditorium behind (CC BY 4.0): the grey stucco canal front with its red doors under a round fanlight, the white letter-board canopy reading FILMTHEATER DE UITKIJK, the framed film poster between two small round-headed windows, three round-headed first-floor windows and the pointed gable with its window, anchor plates and pinnacle. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
